en.text: Keep your distance from Lady Geist!
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Rat King, I can heal you!
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Check out what Rat King bought.
I will walk through all of them.
Today won't be the end of the 7th Moon.
My brother is ready to lend me his aid.
The shadows will be my armor.
If I ever need an arsonist, I know who to call…
You've been doing this for a while, haven't you…
They took out the Rat King!
Perhaps there will be a place for you in the 7th Moon, Wraith.
And now we continue the slaughter.
You made it too easy, Bebop…
The scrap golem never had a chance….
Look out for the black hole!
Come out and die with honor.
年の功も大したことはないな。
You don't belong here, little girl.
New York belongs to the 7th Moon.
Surrender and I'll give you a quick death.
You were a fool to fight me.
Stay if you want, but I'm leaving.
Don't worry Sheriff. Play your part and he lives.
I haven't cut you down where you stand.
I heard you know how to fight.
You will protect me while I slaughter our enemies.
Good. Now try not to die.
Why would I talk to you?
Why would I want you as a friend?
You are a puppy that pisses on the rug. Stupid yet strangely endearing. We will have coffee.
Are there other American Vampires like you?
Have you ever had to kill a man?
That's because you're fighting with children.
Maybe. Prove you're worth my time.
Someone is giving you an order.
I don't have time for this…
Don't worry about me Geist. Take care of yourself.
I can cut that arm off.
No. I seek to build a legacy. Revenge will come when it comes.
Stay out of my head dreamwalker.
When do you try to arrest me?
I have one. Kill them all and ignore your existence.
Don't worry. Soon I'll be the only crime lord.
Ah. Yes. I suppose I am. Be grateful that I kill on your behalf today.
Be quiet or I will butcher you like you butcher my language.
You are the one they call Lash.
I need you to shut up.
I will throw acid in your face.
You conduct yourself with integrity Mirage.
I'm a good friend to have, Mirage.
I don't need your help Calico.
Tell me the name of your cat.
You are the Vatican's killer, yes?
Good. Better you than someone with morals.
I'm not psychotic enough to keep track, or weak enough to remember.
Don't worry Venator. I've never been plagued with a soft heart.
And yet you are still stupid.
I care what you do, not who you are.
Don't stab me in the back, Gargoyle.
Silence worm, before I take your head
I would fall on my sword before I disgraced the 7th Moon by working with you.
You did time on Rikers, yes?
So you must know Molly Molenzo. It's very important I speak to her.
What do you think we're doing?
I don't need your friendship. You need mine.
Don't worry Wraith, I won't take this opportunity to kill you.
Because you'd never see it coming. Which means you are weak. Which means you are of no use to me.
There may be to many of them.
I don't forget what you did.
I wasn't born with this name, but I'll do my best to live up to it.
I can get a better item.
I'll go to the store when I can.
I can get something of quality.
The right item can shape the battle.
I should spend the souls I have.
そして、あなたは私を止められると思ったのですか?
